description: Defines structures, classes, and functions for managing DU (Distributed Unit) bearers, including SRB and DRB connectors, and creation of DRB instances in a 5G network DU implementation.

classes.name: du_srb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a specific SRB.

classes.name: du_drb_connector
classes.description: Handles connection and disconnection of MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a specific DRB.

classes.name: du_ue_srb
classes.description: Represents an SRB in the DU, including its configuration and RLC bearer.

classes.name: du_ue_drb
classes.description: Represents a DRB in the DU, including configuration, RLC bearer, and transport info.

classes.name: drb_creation_info
classes.description: Contains parameters needed to create a DRB in the DU.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a bearer.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects MAC, RLC, and F1 layers for a bearer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops SRB or DRB by disconnecting notifiers and stopping timers.

methods.name: create_drb
methods.description: Creates a DRB instance for the DU based on provided parameters.
